news_items.headline: TD Cowen raises Carpenter Technology (CRS) price target to $470 from $450, maintains Buy
news_items.summary: TD Cowen increased its price target on CRS to $470 (from $450) and kept a Buy rating, the most recent sell-side action of the week.

news_items.headline: Carpenter Technology (CRS) Valuation Check After Record Earnings Beat And Raised Operating Income Guidance
news_items.summary: Valuation piece reviewing CRS after its record earnings beat and raised FY2026 operating income guidance; weighs the premium multiple against continued aerospace/defense demand strength.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: TD Cowen raised PT to $470 from $450 (Buy) this week. Consensus across 8 analysts is Strong Buy (5 Buy / 1 Hold / 0 Sell), avg PT $422.88, range $340-$495. Older (>7d) actions: JP Morgan Overweight, PT $394->$465 (Apr 20); Argus targets up to $500.

earnings_context.notes: Next quarterly report expected ~July 24, 2026 (no near-term earnings inside the trade window). Already priced in: prior record quarter with FY2026 operating income guidance raised to $680M-$700M, driven by aerospace/defense/industrial demand. Street watching execution of $400M brownfield expansion; key risk is a demand slowdown pressuring margins.
